notes.title: Tokyo Rogue is now released!
notes.notes:
It's been a long road of development, filled with struggle but also with perseverance. We have been looking forward to this day for so so long. The day we get to say: Tokyo Rogue is now out on Steam!

There is a 20% launch discount so make sure you pick it up soon! We would love for you to post a review, positive or negative! Whether you want to express you enjoyed it, give feedback, or just vent about being stuck on a level, we want to hear it!

Thank you for joining us on this journey,
The Lunatic Games Dev Team

notes.title: Customization UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
The first iteration of the customization UI was very bare-bones (even that is being generous). After some work, we were able to improve the interface while getting all of the desperately needed functionality implemented.
